versions.description_html:
Learn how Windows Autopilot streamlines new laptop setup for IT teams. Discover hardware hashes, deployment profiles, Intune, and device preparation.

Imagine unboxing a brand-new work laptop and watching it set itself up for your company without an IT person in the room. That's the promise behind Windows Autopilot, and it's why a new hire can be productive on day one instead of day five.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Autopilot Actually Is
  • Why IT Teams Made the Switch
  • How a Device Gets Claimed: The Hardware Hash
  • Deployment Profiles: The Instructions the Device Follows
  • Joining the Organization: Entra Join and Intune
  • The Deployment Modes, Explained Simply
  • The Newer, Simpler Flavor
  • Where It Can Trip You Up
  • Recap and One Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
